title: Agentlist
disclosure: Project creator affiliated with Ambi; uniform evidence rules and an editorial featured default order.

methodology.documented: Supported by official documentation; not independently tested.
methodology.limited: Only partial or conditional support established.
methodology.unknown: Not established by reviewed sources; does not mean unsupported.

relationships.note: Kimi documents deploying OpenClaw in its cloud and connecting existing OpenClaw installations.
MiniMax hosts OpenClaw as MaxClaw, with managed setup, model access, and a cloud workspace.
Google introduced Gemini Spark on the Antigravity harness. The product is now called Gemini Tasks.

news.title: Claude Duet enters research preview
news.summary: Anthropic opens a waitlist for a proactive personal agent, starting with US Pro and Max subscribers.

news.title: OpenClaw publishes v2026.10.5
news.summary: The GitHub release publishes the stable version and links its full changelog. The publication date differs from the version string.

news.title: Underdog adds a Windows beta
news.summary: The official release log announces Windows availability for its local personal assistant.

news.title: Eney launches for Mac and iPhone
news.summary: MacPaw releases Eney with proactive workflows, Mac tools and a 14-day credit trial.

news.title: Hermes v0.22.0 adds guided onboarding and local models
news.summary: Release notes introduce conversational desktop setup, connectors, and a managed llama.cpp runtime. Notes date the release October 13; GitHub publication is October 14 UTC.
news.dateBasis: Release-note date; GitHub publication was October 14 UTC.

news.title: Underdog adds purchases through Link
news.summary: Version 1.4.1 introduces purchases using a one-time Link card approved by the user.

news.title: Hermes Agent arrives in the Microsoft Store
news.summary: Nous Research makes Hermes Agent installable from the Microsoft Store, with more Windows work signalled.

news.title: Hark Pro launches on web, iOS and Android
news.summary: Hark Labs introduces Hark Pro across web and both mobile platforms.

news.title: Skye rebuilds around a contextual home feed
news.summary: Version 1.0.8 introduces a rebuilt home-feed experience for the personal assistant.

news.title: Town 2.0 introduces conversation threads
news.summary: Tasks become shareable threads, with updated approval behavior.

news.title: OpenAI introduces Dots
news.summary: The launch introduces ongoing personal agents with cloud computers, connected apps, and user-defined permissions.

news.title: Wabi 3.0 becomes an AI messenger
news.summary: The release adds group conversations, task assistance, proactive updates, and generated interfaces inside chats.

news.title: Muse for Mac released
news.summary: Meta's chief executive announces a Mac app nine days after launch, describing access to apps, files, calendar, notes and messages with user-controlled permissions.

news.title: nanobot v0.3.5 unifies terminal and browser continuity
news.summary: The release adds a native terminal client sharing saved conversations with the browser, plus improved automation views and session recovery.

news.title: Lucas launches an encrypted credential Vault
news.summary: Vault stores logins, cards and IDs for browser errands while keeping secret fields out of the agent model’s context; purchases still require approval.

news.title: The Gemini app comes to Windows
news.summary: Google ships a Gemini desktop app for Windows, alongside the existing macOS app.

news.title: Meta introduces Muse
news.summary: Meta announces a personal agent in the Muse app and WhatsApp, running on a dedicated virtual machine.

news.title: Grok Bot expands to more subscription plans
news.summary: Access expands to SuperGrok, Cursor Pro, and Cursor Teams plans, with a separate Bot usage allowance.

news.title: Gemini Spark expands to India
news.summary: Google announces a rollout for AI Pro subscribers and describes scheduled and event-driven Workspace tasks.

news.title: Tomo launches its personal AI in iMessage
news.summary: Mapo Labs introduces a goal-focused personal AI with reminders, group chats and connected calendars.

news.title: OpenFang v0.6.0 credits Hermes-inspired features
news.summary: The release adds multi-destination cron delivery, skill configuration templates, and a shared slash-command registry.
